text_block_list.text: The day of the Arima Kinen—

text_block_list.name: Race Fan A
text_block_list.text:
—Huh?
Sounds of Earth put something out.
...Wait, a livestream!?

text_block_list.name: Race Fan B
text_block_list.text:
Huh, isn't that rare?
Uploading videos is one thing, but doing a livestream
on race day isn't something that happens much—

text_block_list.name: Sounds of Earth
text_block_list.text:
—Hello, everyone.
I'm coming to you from the waiting room today.

text_block_list.name: Sounds of Earth
text_block_list.text:
You ask why? Because it's the Grand Prix.
I just wanted to change things up a bit.
...The surging view count made it clear that Sounds of Earth's stream was being watched by a massive audience.

text_block_list.name: Sounds of Earth
text_block_list.text:
...Those who came to Nakayama Racecourse today
to watch the Arima Kinen.

text_block_list.name: Sounds of Earth
text_block_list.text:
Or perhaps those lying in wait
on the other side of a TV or screen.

text_block_list.name: Sounds of Earth
text_block_list.text:
Surely each of them...
has an Umamusume they're cheering for.

text_block_list.name: Sounds of Earth
text_block_list.text:
—And every Umamusume taking the track
has her own personality, dreams, reasons to run, and story to tell.

text_block_list.name: Sounds of Earth
text_block_list.text:
In today's Arima Kinen, all of those elements
converge into a single race—

text_block_list.name: Sounds of Earth
text_block_list.text:
"...It's when Umamusume with rich personalities
stake everything they have to clash on the track."

text_block_list.name: Sounds of Earth
text_block_list.text: It was just like an orchestra, where diverse instruments harmonize together to create a single masterpiece. What it birthed was a symphony of pure ecstasy—

text_block_list.name: Sounds of Earth
text_block_list.text:
To everyone waiting for the Arima Kinen to start,
let's enjoy today together with us Umamusume.

text_block_list.name: Sounds of Earth
text_block_list.text: ――Now then, it is time for music.

text_block_list.name: Sounds of Earth
text_block_list.text: —With this, we've done everything we could.

text_block_list.name: Sounds of Earth
text_block_list.text:
"All that's left...
is to play."
choice_data_list: ...Once again, I have the utmost respect for you.

text_block_list.text:
All the effort and devotion she has poured in
just to create the greatest race.

Because I've watched it all,
because I know it, I feel it so strongly.
choice_data_list: And above all, I want you to enjoy today the most.
And above all, I want you to enjoy today the most.

text_block_list.name: Sounds of Earth
text_block_list.text: Direttore—

text_block_list.name: Sounds of Earth
text_block_list.text: Direttriceâ

The things Sounds of Earth has changed.
The feelings of the Umamusume, the feelings of the race fans.
Among all those things—
There is something right here that will never change.
choice_data_list: Because your sound is my favorite above all else
Because your sound is my absolute favorite.

text_block_list.text:
That is why I will cheer for you the closest.
I will look forward to it the most. I will wish for it the most passionately.

For Sounds of Earth to win
in the racing he loves so much.

text_block_list.name: Sounds of Earth
text_block_list.text:
――Wait for me.
In the winner's circle.

text_block_list.name: Sounds of Earth
text_block_list.text: I'll deliver it to you there.

text_block_list.name: Sounds of Earth
text_block_list.text: Victory, and love.

text_block_list.name: Sounds of Earth
text_block_list.text: ――I'm never letting you go, you know.

text_block_list.name: Aurum Star
text_block_list.text: —Hello there, Earth-kun.

text_block_list.name: Sounds of Earth
text_block_list.text: Greetings, my friend.

text_block_list.name: Aurum Star
text_block_list.text:
...It's a great shame that
Shout couldn't make the adjustments in time.
However, I have a message from her.

text_block_list.name: Aurum Star
text_block_list.text:
“‘Go play the one and only sound of our generation.’
...or so she says.”

text_block_list.name: Sounds of Earth
text_block_list.text: Of course that's the plan. ...Isn't it yours as well?

text_block_list.name: Aurum Star
text_block_list.text:
It goes without saying, my friend.
Our hearts beat as one.

text_block_list.name: Aurum Star
text_block_list.text:
Laaaaa-la-laaaaa~♪♪
We are~~~~ the Golden Generation~~~~♪♪

text_block_list.name: Sounds of Earth
text_block_list.text:
"Laaa—La Laaaa—♪♪
We aaaare~~~~ the generation that composes music~~~~♪♪"

text_block_list.name: Earth & Aurum
text_block_list.text:
"Laaa—La Laaaa—♪♪
We aaaare~~~~ the one and only generaaatiooon—♪♪"

text_block_list.name: Sounds of Earth
text_block_list.text: —Come, let us take the stage!

text_block_list.name: Aurum Star
text_block_list.text: Yeah!
(WOOOOOOOOOOH!!!!)

text_block_list.name: Kitasan Black
text_block_list.text:
—I won't let you win just as you proclaimed!
Today, I'm the one running this festival!

text_block_list.name: Sounds of Earth
text_block_list.text:
Fufu, just try and stop me!
Because my running today is brimming with more love than ever before!!

text_block_list.name: Satono Diamond
text_block_list.text: ――Earth-san.

text_block_list.name: Sounds of Earth
text_block_list.text:
Satono Diamond...
You really came to this Arima Kinen, didn't you?

text_block_list.name: Satono Diamond
text_block_list.text:
...It's all thanks to Earth-san, Kita-chan, and the others
running such a magnificent
Japan Cup.

text_block_list.name: Satono Diamond
text_block_list.text: That race broke through something inside of me.

text_block_list.name: Satono Diamond
text_block_list.text: ...I felt like I had to run in this 'Arima Kinen.'

text_block_list.name: Sounds of Earth
text_block_list.text: Molto bene...! Your presence here today is undoubtedly making this race all the more thrilling!

text_block_list.name: Satono Diamond
text_block_list.text:
Today, I shall let you hear it.
The melody of Satono!

text_block_list.name: Sounds of Earth
text_block_list.text:
Ah...!
Entertain me to my heart's content...!!

text_block_list.name: Sounds of Earth
text_block_list.text: Cheval.

text_block_list.name: Cheval Grand
text_block_list.text: ...Earth-san.

text_block_list.name: Sounds of Earth
text_block_list.text:
...Yes.
Your tone speaks far more eloquently than words ever could.

text_block_list.name: Cheval Grand
text_block_list.text: ...I will win.

text_block_list.name: Sounds of Earth
text_block_list.text: Yeah, bring it on...!

text_block_list.name: Sounds of Earth
text_block_list.text:
Hear us, world!!
Listen to our music!!!
